Hog Production: now expects Q3 adjusted operating profit of $25M to $45M as market hog prices decline.
Packaged Meats: reaffirmed fiscal 2026 adjusted operating income outlook of $1,075M to $1,150M, driven by branded share gains.
Total Company: expects Q3 total adjusted operating income of $115M to $175M; full‑year updates to follow with Q3 results.
